title: No live rank, no board during a run
why: His answer Q71 (10-18): no live rank readout, and no scoreboard until the game is over. The mid-run NEW HIGH SCORE callout is gone, and a window that is out of a live run (benched or extracted) skips the board page in its attract loop.
now: The board and the high-score callout wait until the run is over.
